description: Enabling telemedicine and digital health
long_description: American Well is a leading telehealth platform connecting providers, insurers, innovators, and patients to deliver more affordable, higher quality care. Founded in 2006 in Boston by Dr. Ido Schoenberg and Dr. Roy Schoenberg, the company set out to “enable healthcare providers to see patients not in the room.” Today, American Well powers telehealth solutions for over 130 health systems – including 2,000 hospitals – along with 55 health plan partners and 7,000 employers, reaching more than 150 million people worldwide. With offices in Boston and Tel Aviv, American Well has over 560 employees globally. Americal Well went public on the NYSE in 2020

description: Digital transformation for financial institutions
long_description: Amount helps legacy financial institutions go digital with a fully customizable platform that powers seamless online and mobile customer experiences. Its suite of tools spans credit decisioning, fraud prevention, account verification, risk assessment, marketing, and customer acquisition, enabling banks and lenders to modernize quickly and compete with digital-first challengers. Amount was acquired by FIS in 2025

description: Data based personalized video experience
long_description: Blings has developed a breakthrough video technology that generates videos in real-time, tailored to each user based on data and business logic. This dynamic, interactive approach unlocks entirely new possibilities for brands to personalize content at scale and engage audiences in deeper ways. Already trusted by global leaders like Mercedes-Benz, Singapore Airlines, and McDonald’s, Bling is now building no-code tools that empower video editors to easily add nteractive and personalized elements to their creations.

description: Breakthrough therapies for neurorecovery
long_description: BrainQ is transforming neurorehabilitation with a cloud-based, AI-powered device designed for in-home use. By emitting non-invasive, frequency-tuned extremely low frequency and low intensity electromagnetic fields (ELF-EMF), the technology promotes neurological recovery in the central nervous system. Tailored to each patient through advanced AI, BrainQ offers a groundbreaking solution for the more than one billion people worldwide living with neurodisorders, easing the burden of long-term treatment on both patients and their families.

description: The future of orthodontic care
long_description: Candid is redefining oral health with modern technology and orthodontist-led treatment plans that make straighter smiles more accessible and affordable. Unlike other e-commerce aligner companies, Candid’s approach ensures every treatment plan is designed by licensed orthodontists, delivering high-quality care with less cost and hassle than traditional office visits. Founded in 2017, the New York-based company has earned over 1,000 five-star reviews, operates 11 studios across the US, and is backed by a team of healthcare, tech, and startup veterans from companies including Lyft, BCG, WeWork, Blackstone, and Clover Health.

description: Next-generation 911 infrastructure
long_description: Carbyne is the world’s only cloud-native platform that unifies emergency communications – including video, voice, and data – into a single, real-time system. Its advanced call management technology connects callers, contact centers, and first responders with greater speed and accuracy, enabling faster dispatch, improved data gathering, and ultimately, stronger emergency response outcomes.
location: New York, USA & Tel Aviv, Israel

description: End-to-end global sportswear platform
long_description: Castore is disrupting the global sportswear market with a comprehensive retail platform that delivers end-to-end brand, digital, retail and licensing capabilities. From manufacturing and supply chain management to eCommerce, point of sale, and full-cycle data integration, Castore provides team partners with everything they need to grow and scale. The company employs around 400 people worldwide.

description: Enabling enterprise grade blockchain
long_description: Founded in 2019, Chain Reaction develops ASICs and systems to power the future of blockchain infrastructure. Its dedicated hardware optimizes cryptocurrency mining while enhancing scale, decentralization, and security across enterprise and public blockchain networks. By solving critical bottlenecks in scalability, security and privacy, Chain Reaction is paving the way for blockchain’s next phase of adoption. The company was cofounded by Alon Webman, co-founder of Mellanox Technologies (Acq by Nvidia), and Oren Yokev, former head of the technology division at the Israeli Prime Minister’s Office.

description: Powering restaurants with wholesale food supplies
long_description: Cheetah is the first restaurant supply app, making it simple, fast, and affordable for restaurants to get their daily supplies. Founded by food industry veterans, supply chain and logistics experts, chefs, engineers, and data scientists, the company serves thousands of small businesses across San Francisco and the Bay Area. By streamlining inventory management from hours to minutes, Cheetah helps restaurants lower waste, boost cash flow, and focus more on serving their customers.

description: Customer Acquisition Security
long_description: CHEQ is the global leader in protecting marketing organizations from invalid traffic (IVT). Built by alumni of Israel’s Military Defense Intelligence, CHEQ combines deep cybersecurity expertise with marketing technology to pioneer Customer Acquistion Security (CAS) – one of today’s fastest-growing categories in tech.

description: A full stack machine learning operating system
long_description: Cnvrg.io streamlines and automates machine learning pipelines, enabling enterprises to scale AI with speed and efficiency. Trusted by leading companies across finance, gaming, BI, automotive, manufacturing, e-commerce and more, cnvrg.io delivers a collaborative, end-to-end platform that accelerates innovation. By simplifying the path from data to production, cnvrg.io empowers teams to build and deploy high-impact machine learning models that solve real-world, complex problems. Cnvrg.io was acquired by Intel in 2020

description: Revolutionizing the vet experience for pets and their owners
long_description: Creature Comforts is reinventing the veterinary experience with a focus on preventative pet care, tech-enabled solutions, and a better working environment for vets. Its innovative model combines best-in-class clinics – architecturally designed to keep animals calm – with integrated telehealth services and a monthly subscription that gives pet owners fast access to unlimited care. The result is healthier pets, happier owners, and a more sustainable practice for veterinary professionals.

description: Infrastructure Powering the Future of Financial Services.
long_description: Cross River provides the technology infrastructure powering the future of financial services. With its proprietary real-time banking core, the company delivers scalable embedded solutions for payments, cards, lending and crypto to millions of consumers and businesses. Cross River serves some of the world’s leading fintech and technology companies, and together with its partners, Cross River is reshaping global finance and advancing financial inclusion.

description: A multi-account payment card and app aggregating users' bank cards with unique features like “time travel” to change the card used after the transaction
long_description: Founded in 2015 by Shachar Bialick, Curve is a London‑based fintech innovator reimagining digital wallets for modern consumers. Its singular smart card and app let users consolidate multiple bank and loyalty cards—and even PayPal—into one seamless, powerful interface. Curve stands out for features like “time travel,” enabling users to retroactively switch the funding card for a purchase within 14 days, ensuring flexibility and reducing transaction mistakes With over four million customers using the platform and £3.2 billion in transactions processed in 2022, Curve continues to expand globally—even as it pauses its U.S. card operations to recalibrate its product for market‑specific standards

description: Simplified cloud computing
long_description: DigitalOcean is the cloud services platform built for developers and trusted by businesses to run production applications at scale. In a crowded market, DigitalOcean stands out by prioritizing simplicity and flexibility, empowering developers and teams to build and deploy software faster. Known and loved for its elegant, simple solutions, DigitalOcean serves more than one million users worldwide. Founded in 2011 by brothers Ben and Moisey Uretsky alsongside Mitch Wainer, the company grew out of their earlier venture, ServerStack, a managed hosting provider. Today, DigitalOcean is headquartered in New York, with an office in Boston and a global team of about 500 employees. DigitalOcean went public on the NYSE in 2021

description: The #1 corporate card & expense management platform
long_description: Divvy is a secure financial platform that transforms how businesses manage payments, subscriptions, and expenses. With real-time transaction tracking and smart budgeting tools, Divvy gives companies instant visibility into their spending, helping them optimize cash flow, prevent losses, and eliminate the hassle of reciepts and expense reports for good. Divvy was acquired by Bill.com in 2021

description: Digital transformation for financial services
long_description: EasySend is a no-code platform that helps banks, insurers, and financial service providers replace manual, paper, and pdf-based processes with seamless digital experiences on any device. By harnessing AI and machine learning, EasySend delivers real-time insights into customer interactions, enabling enterprises to optimize processes, accelerate digital product delivery, and elevate customer experiences, all at a fraction of the cost. Leading organizations worldwide, including Zurich Group, Worldline, PCSU Petplan, R+V Versicherung, Harel, and Leumi, rely on EasySend to power their digital transformation.

description: Virtual Patient Simulation for Healthcare Professionals
long_description: Edocate is a virtual patient simulation platform that empowers medical education providers to deliver modern, scalable healthcare training. Founded by physicians, digital health veterans, and Intel alumni, Edocate has become the fastest-growing healthcare/virtual patient simulation platform, powering thousands of hours of chronic care simulations for leading organizations including the American Diabetes Association, American Heart Association, Prime Education, Boston University, HMO’s such as Maccabi and Clalit, Novo Nordisk, Bohringer Ingleheim and many others.

description: Cloud asset management and IaC control.
long_description: Firefly is a Cloud Asset Management solution that gives DevOps, SRE, and Cloud Platform teams complete visibilty and control over their cloud environments. By rediscovering the entire cloud footprint, Firefly identifies which resources are codified vs unmanaged, detect drifts to prevent service failures, and applies Policy-as-Code for smarter governance. With a single inventory spanning multi-cloud and Kubernetes clusters, Firefly helps teams manage, secure, and optimize their cloud assets with confidence.

description: Flex offers financial solutions that build peace of mind for the people who manage properties and the people who live in them.
long_description: Founded in 2019, Flex gives residential renters the ability to split monthly rent into multiple payments, helping them manage cash flow, avoid late fees, and build credit. The solution also benefits landlords and property managers by simplifying rent collection process and offering tenants and attractive payment option.

description: Fondue helps brands drive profitable growth.
long_description: Fondue helps brands drive profitable growth with CashBack, an innovative alternative to traditional discount codes. Seamlessly embedded into the shopping experience, CashBack empowers shoppers to choose the incentive that matters most to them, whether that’s instant savings, store credit, or another reward. The result is higher conversions, stronger engagement, healthier margins, and improved cash flow for brands. Fondue was acquired by Postscript in 2023

description: Optimizing cash flow for small businesses
long_description: Fundbox is a B2B payment and credit network that helps small businesses overcome cash flow challenges and grow with confidence. By advancing payments on thousands of invoices each week, Fundbox eliminates the 30-, 60-, and 90-day delays that often hold businesses back. Acting as a Visa-like network, it enables companies to transact seamlessly without counter-party risk while ensuring everyone gets paid faster. Founded in 2013 by fintech veterans Eyal Shinar, Tomer Michaeli, and Yuval Ariav, Fundbox has been recognized among Forbes A.I. 50, Red Herring North American 100, Forbes Fintech 50 and CB Insights Fintech 250.

description: AI recruiting platform for smarter hiring
long_description: GoPerfect is a next-generation, AI-powered talent acquisition platform built for modern hiring teams from in-house recruiters to agencies. By combining contextual, semantic candidate matching with automated, personalized outreach, GoPerfect helps teams source, engage, and convert candidates more effectively. Key features include career-path prediction, AI-curated outreach via LinkedIn/email/SMS, seamless ATS integration, team collaboration tools, and actionable recruiting insights, all designed to reduce time-to-hire and increase response rates.

description: AI-Driven Currency Hedging Solution
long_description: Grain is a fintech company delivering embedded cross-currency solutions that help businesses manage currency volatility with confidence. Its platform combines seamless API integration, AI-driven adaptive pricing, and end-to-end FX risk protection to make global transactions more predictable and cost-effective. On the consumer side, Grain offers personalized credit lines linked directly to checking accounts for instant access to funds when needed.

description: Building a safer digital world for small businesses
long_description: Guardz is a holistic cyber security and insurance platform designed for small businesses. Its all-in-one, affordable solution runs 24/7, combining cutting-edge protection with simplicity that works equally well for in-house IT teams and MSPs. The platform continuously monitors a company’s entire digital landscape, detects and remediates risks in real time, and backs it all with cyber insurance for added peace of mind. Founded in 2022 by Dor Eisner and Alon Lavi, along with a team of cyber and insurance experts, Guardz blends innovation and experience to create a safer digital world for small businesses.

description: Conversational AI platform for Healthcare
long_description: Hyro builds plug-and-play conversational AI assistants that transform static website content into dynamic voice and chat experiences. By automatically ingesting and structuring existing information into a knowledge graph, Hyro enables users to interact with websites naturally and intuitively, driving higher engagement and conversions. Unlike other solutions, Hyro eliminates the need for complex integrations, playbooks or training data, offering a frictionless deployment and maintenance process. Founded by a technical team from Google Duplex, 8200 and Cornell Tech, Hyro’s mission is to become the default conversational AI layer for enterprises worldwide.

description: Transforming Digital Presence
long_description: Lightricks develops cutting-edge creativity tools that empower users to design, edit, and share stunning visual content directly from their mobile devices. Its suite of apps makes professional-grade creativity accessible to everyone, from casual creators to digital professionals.

description: The Future of Autonomous Preventive Medicine
long_description: Livez is pioneering personalized preventive medicine, built on the insight that 85% of diseases can be prevented through timely screenings and immunizations. By digitizing clinical preventive care and applying AI, Livez delivers personalized, frictionless health recommendations at scale. Tailored to each user’s age, health plan, location, risk factors and medical history, the platform helps reduce insurance claims while improving quality of life.

description: Digital transformation for medication management system
long_description: MDI improves patient outcomes and reduces healthcare costs by enabling providers to deliver data-driven polypharmacy management (MTM) at scale. Its AI-powered platform personalizes drug therapy, recording and analyzing medication data to ensure treatment efficacy, safety, and early detection of potential issues. While MTM is a proven life-saving practice, it has historically been costly and limited to only the highest-risk patients. MDI digitizes and automates the process, making MTM accessible to all populations. The company is already partnering with leading providers and payers in Israel and the US across diverse use-cases.

description: Unlocking R&D Black Box
long_description: Milestone uses AI to unlock the vast hidden data within code, turning it into actionable insights that help organizations boost efficiency and accelerate revenue growth. By transforming complex codebases into clear business intelligence, Milestone empowers leaders to make smarter, data-driven decisions.

description: The data platform for global mobility
long_description: Moovit is the world’s #1 urban mobility app, helping more than 800 million users across 3,200 cities navigate public transportation with real-time routing and timing data. Backed by the largest global repository of mobility data, Moovit powers a unique Mobility-as-a-service solution used worldwide. Founded in 2012 and acquired by Intel in 2020, the company operates in 45 languages with offices in Tel Aviv and 20 additional locations around the globe. Moovit was acquired by Intel in 2020

description: AI copilot for property management teams
long_description: Muvan AI is building Lori, a “pure‑AI copilot” for asset and property management teams. Lori unifies real estate data into a single workflow, automates repetitive tasks (like weekly reporting), provides contextual insights, and makes portfolio understanding accessible through natural language queries and intuitive dashboards.

description: Travel Data that Drives Business
long_description: Oversee (formerly FairFly) is the global leader in Travel Spend Optimization, trusted by 29 of the Fortune 100, 86 of the Fortune 500, and 38 of BTN Corporate Travel 100. For nearly a decade, enterprises have relied on Oversee’s AI-powered airfare & hotel price assurance, along with advanced travel data analytics, to capture savings, optimize supplier relations, and maximize return on travel investment. In addition to serving corporate travel programs, Oversee partners with travel agencies, TMCs, and OTAs to boost automation, streamline operations, and increase profitability, empowering travel managers with end-to-end insights that consistently drive millions in savings.

description: Securely manage held-away retirement accounts
long_description: Pontera (formerly Feex) empowers individuals to grow their retirement wealth by enabling financial advisors to securely trade and manage held-away assets, such as 401(k)s. By making these accounts part of truly holistic financial planning, Pontera helps clients achieve stronger financial outcomes while giving advisors the ability to offer greater peace of mind. The secure platform aligns the interests of all parties, and Pontera has formed partnerships with leading advisor technology solutions and some of the most recognized financial firms. Pontera is headquartered in New York and has over 100 employees.
location: New York, United States & Hezliya, Israel

description: Managing a decentralized network of technicians
long_description: Puls is transforming home services with a decentralized network of skilled handymen and appliance professionals. By directly matching consumers with warranty plans and repair services, Puls delivers convenience, peace of mind and predictable costs for homeowners. Since launch, the company has served more than 1 million customers and built a nationwide network of over 8,000 providers. Headquartered in California, Puls also operates offices in New York and Tel Aviv. Puls merged with Super Home in 2024
location: San Francisco & San Diego, USA, Tel Aviv, Israel

description: The next OS for Customer Support
long_description: Quack is building an AI-driven intelligence platform that helps enterprises understand customer problems more deeply and resolve them faster and with greater accuracy. By transforming customer interactions into actionable insights, Quack empowers companies to deliver smarter support and stronger customer experiences.

description: Pioneering 3D-printed Alternative Meat
long_description: Founded in 2018, Redefine Meat is transforming the future of food with breakthrough 3D printing technology that creates plant-based meats indistinguishable from their animal counterparts. Driven by the urgent need for sustainable food solutions, the company delivers beef, lamb, and other high-value meat alternative that look, cook, and taste like the real thing. Scalable, cost-effective, and compassionate, Redefine meat is redefining how the world eats.

description: Disrupting the Traditional Dairy Industry
long_description: Remilk is reinventing dairy with a next-generation approach that eliminates the environmental and ethical costs of traditional milk production. Using innovative processes, Remilk creates dairy products that are healthier, cleaners, and far more sustainable, yet identical in taste, texture, and experience to conventional dairy.

description: Cybersecurity for Enterprise Applications
long_description: RevealSecurity protects enterprises from malicious insiders and imposters by monitoring user journeys across any application – Saas, cloud, or custom-built. Its unique user journey analytics and clustering engine detect abnormal behavior without relying on application-specific rules, enabling accurate detection of malicious activity even when attackers bypass authentication or abuse legitimate permissions.

description: Next-Gen Tool for Ecommerce
long_description: Route is reimagining eCommerce with a platform that connects and empowers both consumers and brands. Through the Route app, shoppers can discover and celebrate products from around the world, while merchants gain powerful tools to enhanced the often-overlooked post-purchase experience. From delivery tracking to brand discovery, Route takes a holistic approach to online shopping that benefits customers and merchants alike.

description: The winning model for SMB insurance
long_description: Sayata helps insurance carriers and brokers grow their businesses with a platform that streamlines underwriting and enhances the broker experience. Through its marketplace, brokers can deliver superior service to SMB clients, while insureds gain clear visibility into their own risk profiles. The result is faster, smarter insurance distribution that benefits all parties. Sayata was acquired by Global Indemnity

description: Seemore Data is an end-to-end, data product optimization platform, built to attribute data spend and maximize data ROI, across all pipelines and stacks.
long_description: Founded in 2023, Seemore Data is the first data efficiency platform designed to maximize the ROI of data products. By offering unparalleled visibility and actionable insights across the entire data pipeline and stack, Seemore optimizes data costs and performance without compromising business value. The platform enables data leaders to prioritize high-impact initiatives while enforcing strong cost governance to eliminate wasteful spending.

description: The World’s First Intelligence Network For Trees
long_description: SeeTree is transforming agriculture with an “intelligence platform for trees” that delivers per-tree insights to help growers track trees’ health and productivity at scale. Combining military-grade technology, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning tools, SeeTree’s data scientists, agronomists, forest rangers and drone operators digitize entire orchards, empowering growers to boost yields while saving water and cutting costs.

description: Protecting against malicious hardware attacks
long_description: Sepio is a leader in Rogue Device Mitigation (RDM), protecting organizations against hardware-based attacks with its SaaS platform, Sepio Prime. The solution gives security teams full visibility into all hardware assets and their behavior in real time, backed by granular policy enforcement to monitor and protect infrastructure continuously. By combining physical fingerprinting technology with device behavior analytics, Sepio delivers instant detection and response to threats from manipulated or infected devices, ensuring stronger, more resilient security.

description: Blockchain compliance and enablement
long_description: Solidus Labs delivers market surveillance and transaction monitoring solutions purpose-built for digital assets, bridging the gap between traditional finance and the new digital economy. Built by veteran Wall Street FinTech engineers, its machine learning-driven platform detects, investigates, and manages threats in digital asset trading. Exchanges, broker dealers, market makers and other financial service providers rely on Solidus to ensure client protection, reduce regulatory risks and streamline compliance.

description: Developing a purpose-built Analytics Processing Unit (APU) for big-data and AI workloads
long_description: Speedata is an Israel‑based fabless semiconductor startup founded in 2019 by a team of serial entrepreneurs and academic leaders. It develops an advanced Analytics Processing Unit (APU) purpose‑built to accelerate large‑scale big data and AI workloads—filling a gap traditional CPUs cannot efficiently address. With around $114 million raised across three funding rounds and bolstered by a $44 million Series B in mid‑2025, Speedata is positioning itself as a formidable challenger to incumbents like Nvidia in the high‑performance data space .

description: SpotItEarly is an Israeli med-tech startup harnessing the combined power of AI and canine olfaction to develop a simple breath test for the early detection of multiple cancers. By leveraging dogs’ advanced sense of smell alongside cutting-edge technology, the company is pioneering a non-invasive approach to cancer screening. Following a successful seed round, SpotItEarly is advancing clinical research and product development to bring its breakthrough solution to market.
The GPU accelerated data warehouse
long_description: Sqream is a leading data warehousing company that increases the speed and reduces the costs of data analytics. SQream’s GPU data warehouse enables rapid analysis of terabytes to petabytes of raw data eliminating the need for arduous preparation while reducing reporting time from hours to minutes. Companies such as ACL, AIS, Cellcom, and HP Arcsight use SQream DB’s to increase the speed and reduce the costs of their data analytics. The company was founded in 2010 by CEO Ami Gal and CTO Razi Shoshani with the goal of speeding up database processing with cost-effective GPUs. The company is based in New York, NY and has an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and has 80 employees globally.

description: The first customer training cloud
long_description: Strigo helps companies transform customer training into a powerful driver of product adoption and long-term success. Its customer training cloud streamlines training activities and delivers hands-on, insight-driven experiences across multiple channels and stages of the customer journey, empowering customers to get the most value from every product.

description: UVeye has created the world’s first fully-automated vehicle-inspection system. Using proprietary algorithms, cloud architecture, artificial intelligence, machine learning and sensor-fusion technologies, its drive-thru platforms can scan any vehicle in seconds and detect mechanical issues, exterior damage, tire problems, underbody risks, and foreign objeccts. From oil leaks to dents, tread wear and beyond, UVeye delivers a fast, comprehensive, and objective inspection process that transforms vehicle safety and maintenance.
location: Rishon LeTsiyon, Israel, New Jersey & Ohio, USA

description: The digital infrastructure for public mobility
long_description: Via is redefining public mobility with technology that makes transportation smarter, more efficient, and responsive to demand. Inspired by Israel’s “Sherut” shared taxis, Via focuses on carpools, shuttles, and transit partnerships rather than individual rides. Its platform helps cities, transit agencies, schools, and corporations optimze routes, increase efficiency, and expand access, while in some cases also operating the services directly. Founded in 2012 by Daniel Ramot and Oren Shoval and launched in New York City the following year, Via now operates in more than 20 countries, has provided over 70 million rides, and partners with more than 90 organizations worldwide. Headquarted in NYC with a Tel Aviv office, the company employees over 500 people globally. Via went public on the NYSE in 2025

description: Preventing customer journey hijacking
long_description: Wandz.ai (Formerly Namogoo) is a real-time predictive AI platform that helps brands adapt every customer’s online journey in milliseconds. By capturing and analyzing behavioral signals, Wandz predicts user intent, affinity, and next actions—then dynamically adjusts the experience to maximize engagement, conversion, and retention. Its no-code SaaS platform integrates easily with existing analytics, personalization, and marketing tools, delivering measurable uplift in revenue and conversion for retail and e-commerce leaders like Kurt Geiger, Carhartt, and Ulta Beauty.

description: Powering Brand Loyalty With Integrated Ecommerce Marketing.
long_description: Yotpo is a fast-growing SaaS marketing platform that helps commerce brands turn traffic into sales via a unified solution. Instead of juggling multiple tools, brands can manage SMS, reviews, loyalty programs, subscriptions, and visual UGC all in one place. Yotpo has served over 6,000 brands worldwide including innovative brands such as Everlast, MVMT, GoPro, and Steve Madden. The company empowers D2C and eCommerce companies to drive growth and deepen customer relationships.

description: Developing compact, long-duration nuclear batteries (radioisotope power systems) for defense, space, and remote environments
long_description: Headquartered in Washington, D.C., Zeno Power is pioneering nuclear batteries powered by radioisotope decay—capable of delivering reliable heat and electricity for years in harsh environments like space, polar regions, and deep seas. Having secured over $50 million in Series B funding and over $60 million in contracts from NASA and the U.S. Department of Defense, Zeno is shifting from early prototyping to scalable manufacturing. Its groundbreaking batteries are set to power everything from lunar landers to undersea infrastructure.

description: AI-powered cloud vulnerability remediation platform
long_description: ZEST was founded to tackle one of the biggest challenges in cloud security: resolving risks at scale. Its AI-powered risk resolution platform automatically correlates and pinpoints the root cause of cloud vulnerabilities and misconfigurations, then generates resolution paths to eliminate them. By integrating with existing tools and infrastructure, such as Code (IaC), Zest enables security teams to resolve cloud risks before an attacker can exploit them.
